original_test_intent: Confirm that the physical LED on the intended shared BMC connector reflects the actual negotiated link state and speed according to the approved platform LED specification.
original_method: Bind the shared connector and switch peer, capture machine link/speed baseline, have an operator connect the correct cable and photograph the LED, then correlate physical indication with authenticated BMC/network status.
manual_activity: An operator verifies the port label, performs the approved cable connection and captures a timestamped unobstructed LED photo tied to the machine status sample.
required_inputs: Exact shared BMC connector and interface map
Vendor LED color/blink/link/speed matrix and timing tolerance
safety_requirements: Coordinate cable action with network owner
Do not change BMC or switch configuration to force LED
Stop on port ambiguity or active dependency impact
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete authenticated link/speed status before and after
Timestamp and correlate operator photo/cable state
Do not perform physical action or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only status is relevant, but insecure endpoint assumptions and grep-filtered output omit identity, raw fields and the specification comparison.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete trusted interface and LAN link/speed evidence synchronized with the operator's exact shared-port cable action and LED photo.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Shared-port plug action, physical LED criterion and 5/5-minute values remain; no configuration change is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate exact connector/cable state, raw machine link/speed and timestamped LED photo.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds device identity, switch context, LED semantics and secure raw evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Machine link alone cannot prove physical color/blink behavior; photo alone cannot prove negotiated state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong cable action may interrupt management or affect an adjacent system.

project_override_considerations: Camera or machine-vision evidence may assist, but the physical connector and platform-specific LED matrix must remain explicit; interface JSON cannot substitute for the visual criterion.
expected_evidence: Complete raw authenticated pre/post link and speed output with exit status
Timestamped cable-state record and LED photo
Correlation report, events, no-mutation audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently defines shared-port LED validation; missing visual semantics are normal platform inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Port mapping, LED specification, operator and tools can be supplied, enabling hybrid execution.

review_improvement: Makes the physical LED observation attributable to the correct shared connector and negotiated link instead of relying on insecure filtered queries.
independent_technical_reasoning: LED correctness is a cross-domain oracle: physical indication must match actual link/speed, so neither software telemetry nor a photo is sufficient alone. Human cable/photo work and automated telemetry must be synchronized.
